verdict: Not ready for full phase-one sign-off
scope: Runnable backend and web PWA foundation, checked against the initial MVP proposal; no separately agreed formal phase-one acceptance list exists.

requirements.evidence: Production build succeeded; frontend and proxied health endpoints returned HTTP 200.
Frontend creates a learner and six-node Flutter roadmap. Only a fixed template is implemented; preferences do not personalize nodes.
Submitted source text in the browser; background job completed and downloaded a packet to IndexedDB.

requirements.requirement: PDF ingestion in the initial MVP
requirements.evidence: Source schema accepts text and transcript only; no PDF extraction adapter or PDF upload route.

requirements.requirement: AI summaries, examples and subject-specific quizzes
requirements.evidence: DevelopmentGenerator slices source text and creates a status-check question. It makes no AI calls.
UTF-8 limit and quiz schema tested on backend and frontend; live demo packet is 1994 bytes.
Generated preview and starter lesson saved in IndexedDB and visible in the browser library.
Starter quiz scored 2 of 2; answers and study completion survived a page reload.

requirements.requirement: Reading and quiz submissions without backend connectivity
requirements.evidence: Stopped both application services; opened saved packet, reset quiz, selected answers and checked them successfully.

Reload with both services stopped rendered a blank page in the embedded Codex browser, including on a fresh localhost origin. Standard-browser/device test unavailable because computer-use permission was not granted.
Implementation selects local English speech voices; Listen was available in this browser. Audible offline playback was not verified.
Manifest, PNG icons and service worker are built. Actual installation and installed-app cold reopening were not verified.
Template includes career tasks, but marketEvidence is null and no local hiring evidence is verified.
Not implemented; the earlier MVP plan deferred discovery/transcript retrieval until after the core flow.

blocking_next_steps: Implement source-grounded AI lesson generation and validate teaching content.
Implement PDF text extraction for the initial MVP.
Resolve or explain the observed cold-reopen failure and pass an installed/standard-browser offline acceptance test.
verification_limits: Passing service-worker unit tests does not establish real-device offline reopening.
Initial app shell is larger than 100KB; the size limit applies to each packet.
Demo packets are unreviewed source previews; they do not establish skill mastery.
snapshot_note: This audit predates the addition of Solar Inverter Technician, Frontend Web Developer, and Data Analyst curated pathways. It records the earlier state; the new catalog does not add AI personalization.
